name: Getac ZX10-EX (first generation)
statusNote: Getac now lists the G2 generation in its place; it published no end-of-sale date.
summary: The Getac ZX10-EX (first generation) is the hazardous-area version of a Getac rugged 10.1-inch tablet, certified for Zone 2/22 under IECEx. Getac also states ATEX certification, but the certificate isn't published. It is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) design running Android 12. It has been discontinued; the Getac ZX10-EX G2 replaces it.

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ic op is IIC T4 Gc / II 3D Ex ic op is IIIC T130°C Dc
atex.status: IECEx Current, issue 2, checked 2026-10-25; ATEX not published

iecex.marking: Ex ic op is IIC T4 Gc / Ex ic op is IIIC T130°C Dc

certification.protection: Intrinsic safety (Ex ic) with inherently safe optical radiation (op is)

safety.conditions: As ZX10 G2: protect from UV and mechanical impact; interfaces never used in hazardous areas; battery never changed, charged or removed in hazardous areas; not next to strong charge-generating processes; batteries BP1S1P4990B or BP1S2P4990B.
safety.peripherals: All connection interfaces (USB, Thunderbolt, DC-in, docking connector, LAN, serial) must never be used in hazardous areas (certificate condition). Optional internal modules named in the certificate are covered as part of the certified tablet.
safety.certifiedAccessories: Named in the certificate (issue 0): hand strap, shoulder strap or harness strap, capacitive soft-tip stylus and tether. Chargers and adapters not for hazardous areas.

specs.ports: USB 3.2 Gen1 Type-C, USB 2.0 host, DC-in, microSD; optional smart card, barcode, HF RFID/NFC combo

capabilities.label: RFID
capabilities.value: Built in (optional HF RFID/NFC combo reader)

unconfirmed.certification.iecex.number: Getac's certificate names the model with a 'c' suffix and doesn't name the generation. We matched it to this generation by its batteries, dust group and ambient range.
unconfirmed.os.securityUntil: Getac's date for the standard model; Getac lists no separate date for the EX version.
unconfirmed.launchYear: Approximate: the maker doesn't publish a launch date. Based on the certificate date or the maker's announcement.

strengths: Among the lightest Zone 2 tablets of its size we list, at 1040 g in use
limitations: Discontinued; the Getac ZX10-EX G2 replaces it
Zone 2 only, so not for Zone 1 areas
T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
